eye_spacing.definition: The horizontal distance between the inner canthus of the left and right eyes.
eye_spacing.engineering_purpose: Defines the core horizontal center-balance of the upper face, anchoring the visual identity.
eye_spacing.mathematical_definition: Euclidean distance between MediaPipe landmark 133 and 362, normalized to temple width.
eye_spacing.extraction_algorithm: 3D Euclidean distance calculation derived from normalized 478-point mesh coordinates.
eye_spacing.confidence_interpretation: Requires highly visible, non-occluded inner eyes. Drops significantly in profile views.
eye_spacing.failure_conditions: Heavy shadows around the nose bridge, thick glasses frames obscuring the canthus, extreme profile yaw.
eye_spacing.relationship_to_neighboring: Acts as the baseline divider for facial_width and directly influences the perceived width of the nose bridge.
eye_spacing.correction_strategy: If confidence < 0.5, attempt to infer from contralateral symmetry if a 3/4 profile exists. Otherwise, flag for manual review.
eye_spacing.provider_sensitivity: High sensitivity in Stable Diffusion 3.5; often collapses if eyes are too close together.
eye_spacing.future_research_required: Need better distinction between epicanthic folds and true canthus points across diverse ethnicities.

temple_width.definition: The horizontal distance between the left and right temporal bones (widest part of the upper skull).
temple_width.engineering_purpose: Establishes the absolute maximum width constraint of the skull for generative bounding boxes.
temple_width.mathematical_definition: Euclidean distance between MediaPipe landmark 162 and 389.
temple_width.extraction_algorithm: Maximum horizontal span calculation on the coronal plane.
temple_width.confidence_interpretation: Requires frontal or near-frontal view. Drops to 0 in pure profile views.
temple_width.failure_conditions: Heavy bangs or voluminous hair covering the temples causes the mesh to hallucinate the bone structure underneath.
temple_width.relationship_to_neighboring: Used as the normalization denominator for almost all internal facial ratios (e.g., eye_spacing / temple_width).
temple_width.correction_strategy: If occluded by hair, fall back to cheekbone width + estimated temporal offset based on demographic priors.
temple_width.provider_sensitivity: Medium. Most models get generic skull width correct, but struggle with precise width-to-height ratios without LoRA.
temple_width.future_research_required: Researching Depth-Anything integration to penetrate hair occlusion and find true temporal depth.

nose_projection.definition: The forward Z-axis depth from the alar base to the tip of the nose.
nose_projection.engineering_purpose: Crucial for profile silhouette accuracy and lighting (shadow casting).
nose_projection.mathematical_definition: Delta Z between the pronasale (tip) and the subnasale (base).
nose_projection.extraction_algorithm: Z-axis depth isolation from the 3D local coordinate frame of the face mesh.
nose_projection.confidence_interpretation: Highest in profile views. Extremely low in flatly-lit frontal views due to loss of depth cues.
nose_projection.failure_conditions: Direct frontal flash photography destroys the shading required for the monocular depth estimator to infer Z-axis projection.
nose_projection.relationship_to_neighboring: Heavily influences the perceived lip_projection and profile_identity.
nose_projection.correction_strategy: Force extraction from a PROFILE_LEFT or PROFILE_RIGHT view. Do not trust FRONTAL Z-axis estimations.
nose_projection.provider_sensitivity: Very High. AI models frequently flatten noses or mutate them into generic button noses without strong depth conditioning.
nose_projection.future_research_required: Integration of stereo photogrammetry or explicit 3D Gaussian Splatting for true volumetric measurement.

hair_curl.definition: The textural classification of hair wave frequency (straight, wavy, curly, coily).
hair_curl.engineering_purpose: Drives the textural conditioning and prompt formulation for hair generation.
hair_curl.mathematical_definition: The standard deviation of Laplacian variance within the segmented hair region mask.
hair_curl.extraction_algorithm: Canny edge detection over the hair mask, followed by frequency domain analysis to count edge inversions per square inch.
hair_curl.confidence_interpretation: Requires high-resolution, sharply focused inputs. Drops to 0 on blurry or low-res images.
hair_curl.failure_conditions: Motion blur, low resolution, or highly specular lighting hitting dark hair destroys the edge detection.
hair_curl.relationship_to_neighboring: Affects the overall silhouette volume of the head.
hair_curl.correction_strategy: If confidence < 0.6 due to blur, classify as INFERRED based on global image prompt context, or leave as MISSING.
hair_curl.provider_sensitivity: High. Generators struggle with precise coily hair, often smoothing it into generic waves.
hair_curl.future_research_required: Need a dedicated Neural Texture Classifier trained specifically on the Andre Walker Hair Typing System.

pore_density.definition: The frequency and depth of visible pores on the skin surface (primarily cheeks and nose).
pore_density.engineering_purpose: Prevents the 'plastic' AI look by enforcing realistic skin imperfections.
pore_density.mathematical_definition: High-frequency noise calculation over a color-normalized skin patch.
pore_density.extraction_algorithm: Isolate the cheek patch, apply CLAHE (Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization), and measure high-frequency variance.
pore_density.confidence_interpretation: Extremely dependent on megapixel count. Meaningless on images below 1080p.
pore_density.failure_conditions: Heavy makeup, severe jpeg compression, or low-resolution completely erases pores.
pore_density.relationship_to_neighboring: Informs the generation of micro-wrinkles and specularity mapping.
pore_density.correction_strategy: If resolution is too low, default to HEURISTIC average for the subject's estimated age group.
pore_density.provider_sensitivity: High. FLUX.2 tends to over-smooth unless explicitly forced by a high-frequency LoRA.
pore_density.future_research_required: Differentiating between true pores and jpeg artifacting at a sub-pixel level.
